notes.title: Save System Replaced (Build 11)
notes.content:
[Windows Only] A major bug has been identified in the old (registry-based) save system which was resulting in a lot of data being maintained in the registry which did not need to be there. Tonight I've replaced the save system with the newer file-based system that I wrote for the macOS and iOS releases. I've also added a one-time converter which will remove all of the game's old registry data and rewrite "the good bits" into the new file-based saves.

If you experience any issues, please get in touch and let me know the details.

macOS players should see no change/are not affected.

NOTE: If you have modified the registry-based saved data manually, it may not correctly convert to the new file format and your saves may be lost.

notes.title: Wait... so the enemies are all bright PINK?!
notes.content:
...now THAT'S an interesting design choice.

I received a bug report via Twitter today regarding this shader issue. This was unfortunately an old bug that somehow managed to work its way back into a build. I've now corrected this and uploaded an update. You'll know you're on the correct version if you see "Build -10-" on the title screen.

Apologies for the issue. That looked crap.

notes.title: Now Available On MacOS!
notes.content: Hey all - very happy to announce that The Deep Paths: Labyrinth Of Andokost is now available on both Windows and MacOS via Steam. As a (primarily) Mac user myself, this was long overdue! Enjoy :)

notes.title: Keyboard Mapping Added
notes.content: Hi all - I've just uploaded Build 3 which now has The Deep Paths specific key mappings in the "Input" tab of the launcher. These are prefaced with "TDP". You can use these to assign your own key mappings for the keyboard controls in the game.

notes.title: Labyrinth Of Andokost Now Available!
notes.content:
Well, it's been quite a while in development, but "The Deep Paths: Labyrinth Of Andokost" is finally available.

If you like your RPGs seriously old-fashioned, like your grandma used to play, then hit that "Add To Cart" button right now!

I hope you enjoy playing the game.

Cheers,
Steve J.
